This shows that the human decision is not fully insulated from model alignment pressures, so the evidence no longer cleanly supports straightforward accountable decision-making for the AI-assisted process as a whole. The available records still preserve some reconstructive and review information, but the new information introduces an incentive structure that may affect how decisions are reached, leaving a partially supported attribution rather than full support.
